referenceFrames.sceneChange: wreck-descended holds S for 1200 frames instead of 75, and scripts/pixi-visual-check.mjs asserts the HUD reads 15 m or deeper before capturing: from the surface, 75 frames left the diver 0.3 m down and the camera unmoved, so the scene no longer covered the camera travel and culling resync it exists for. wreck-torch-off now holds S for 1200 frames and asserts 15 m or deeper before it presses T, as the torch works only while diving (#223 Codex round 1); it differs from wreck-descended only in the beam.

portedFromTheOracle.surfaceStart: src/game-loop.js updateSurface(): no dive time at the surface, and S or the down arrow the only input; the cylinder, setpoint and bailout keys and buttons wait for the dive, as legacy reads them only in updateDiving() and shows only its descend button at the surface. S applies updateSurface()'s 2 L in the BCD, at rest, and the loop's PO2 through DiveModel.leaveSurface(): a fresh state already holds those, a legacy save written at the surface holds 0 L. Legacy's 'surface' autosave is kept: the waiting state is handed to the save.
portedFromTheOracle.bounds: Legacy's ceilingAt/floorAt, solidAt and overheadAt, on the migration scene's own hull (src/sites/wreck-route.ts, which the renderer now draws from): the surface to 34 m outside the hold; over the cargo hold and engine room, open water above the deck and, under it, the deck's underside to the hold's 33.5 m floor, which is the overhead. A horizontal stroke into the hull is not made. The under-deck space ends at the stern wall the scene draws, from (99, 33.5) to (103, 29.5); past it there is only water above the deck.
portedFromTheOracle.completion: Surfacing outside the wreck reaches the model's completion (slice 4b); under the deck the diver cannot surface. As legacy's clearSavedDive() on leaving 'diving', the app clears the save on the first completed state and writes none after it, and the ended dive claims no keys.
portedFromTheOracle.fastForward: canFastForward = atDecoStop || atSafetyStop, the safety-stop half deferred from #206.
portedFromTheOracle.surface: src/renderer.js drawScene: the sky gradient #c4e6f0 to #83bcd2, the two-sine wave band in rgba(135,206,235,0.3) a metre deep, and the _drawSurfaceUnderside highlight.
portedFromTheOracle.ndl: src/renderer.js drawDiveComputer: `ndl >= 999 ? '---' : ndl > 99 ? '99' : ndl`, reachable since the dive starts at the surface; the HUD shows the unavailable mark and whole minutes up to 99 through the gas page's ndlText().
